page.content:
British prime minister of the defiance years and the Grand Alliance.

How Winston Churchill connects

  • Faction: Allies — Churchill was Britain's wartime leader in the Grand Alliance.
  • Event: The Blitz — Churchill's government held through the Blitz.
  • Work: Atlantic Charter — Churchill and Roosevelt issued the Atlantic Charter in 1941.
  • Event: Dunkirk evacuation — Dunkirk was the first crisis of Churchill's premiership.

What is Winston Churchill?

Winston Churchill took office in May 1940, refused a compromise peace during the Blitz, and held Britain in the war until American and Soviet weight could turn it.

Key threads lead to Allies, The Blitz, Atlantic Charter and Dunkirk evacuation.
